Hey, I’m Agon — a software developer who enjoys making complicated things feel simple.

My work spans ERP and business software, websites, web applications, and mobile applications. I like connecting the dots between a real problem, a considered interface, and the system that makes it all work.

Whether it’s a business running smoother or a small interaction feeling just right, I care about what happens on both sides of the screen.
